summary: Candidate is a distinct D3 micro_skill for local variable lifecycle management with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills cover async callbacks, data transformation, and layout shift prevention—none address scoped variable declaration, assignment, retrieval, or cleanup in D3 contexts. Peer candidates (InternMap, locale formatters, scale normalization) are orthogonal data structure and formatting concerns. Support evidence confirms d3.local() API exists and is documented.
